basis: Inherited bilateral or multifocal renal oncocytomas; association with Birt-Hogg-Dube does not establish its other manifestations.
Isolated hair-shaft disorder with uncombable, dry, canaliculated hair.
LPAR6-related isolated hypotrichosis and woolly hair; documented manifestations affect hair and occasionally nails.
CNS and cervico-occipital skeletal malformations define disease; cardiovascular malformations and gastroschisis each 30-79%; renal agenesis 5-29%.
Occlusion of the carotid artery; cerebral infarction is a possible separately diagnosed complication, not inherent to every occlusion.
Hantavirus infection defined by renal failure and hemorrhagic disease, typically with thrombocytopenia; blurred vision alone does not establish ocular damage.
Distal muscular dystrophy causing skeletal muscle weakness and atrophy; no evidence of primary nerve disease.
Inherited dilated cardiomyopathy, documented in 5/5 patients, with ventricular dysfunction and arrhythmia.
Neurodevelopmental disorder with intellectual disability and developmental delay; strabismus affects ocular alignment in 30-79%; optic atrophy and skeletal defects each <30%.
Deficient hypothalamic TRH secretion causes central hypothyroidism; endocrine dysfunction alone does not establish additional neurologic damage.
Combined immunodeficiency with autoimmune cytopenias; hepatic nodular regenerative hyperplasia 2/4; bronchiectasis 1/5; infections and hypothyroidism are separate diagnoses.
Chronic cutaneous plaque dermatitis; rare progression does not establish lymphoma or systemic organ involvement.
Familial excessive adrenal androgen secretion defines an endocrine disorder; no additional organ damage is established.
Silver deposition defines persistent skin and nail discoloration; mucosal staining and systemic deposits do not establish functional organ damage.
Malignancy arising in the conjunctiva; lymphoma is only one subtype and does not define the umbrella concept.
Hemolytic blood disease; intrinsic bone infarction/necrosis is common (HPO avascular necrosis 30-79%); retinopathy, CKD and gallstones are separately diagnosed complications.
Alloreactive immune injury targets skin, gut and liver; hepatic injury is a core diagnostic/staging manifestation, retained as involved because primary is capped at three.
Invasive mucinous adenocarcinoma arising in rectal glandular epithelium.
SAG-related retinal degeneration with rod-cone dystrophy, chorioretinal atrophy and visual impairment.
Arterial disease, joint laxity (~86%) and cutis laxa define syndrome; cleft palate 30-79%; keratoconus 21%; refractive errors alone do not establish ocular tissue damage.
Scarring causes inward rotation of the eyelid; eyelids belong to the ocular axis.
Glycosylation disorder defined by myopathy, epilepsy and cerebral atrophy; respiratory distress does not establish lung damage, nor eyelid narrowing functional ocular damage.
Cerebral vessel fragility and resulting structural brain injury define disease; leukoencephalopathy and cerebral calcification documented in 2/2.
Benign teratoma originates in the ovary, outside the axes; thyroid-type differentiation alone does not establish endocrine dysfunction or thyroid-gland disease.
Malignant peripheral nerve sheath tumor; glandular differentiation does not change its nerve-sheath origin.
